title: ever SAGE|High Low Ruched Chiffon Ruffle Sleeve Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
Why you??ll love it

  • Airy flutter sleeves add light coverage and keep arms comfortable all day.
  • A softly ruched waistband defines the waist with a little forgiveness through the midsection.
  • The floaty chiffon skirt skims over hips and thighs (no cling), while the high-low hem adds movement and shows off your shoes in photos.

Best for
Bridesmaid duties from ceremony to reception, outdoor weddings, garden venues, beach vows, rehearsal dinners, and after-party dancing.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: High low.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
